item.tib: gsang mchog rol pa'i rgyud las drag dbang nyon mongs rang grol bdud bzhi dpung 'jom
item.coloph: ces gsang mchog rol pa mthar thugs drag dbang nyon mongs rang grol bdud bzhi dpung gzhom zhes bya ba 'di/ me pho sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu la/ lho nub pad ma 'bar ba'i zhing khams su/ gsang bdag bad dzar slob dpon chen po dang / gsang yum Dak+ki bde byed dmar mo yis/ dbang bskur gsang ba'i bka' rgya bcas te gsang/ kho bo bdag gis gsang rgya thub par byas/ de nas phyi rabs 'gro la phan phyir dang / me mo lug gi lo zla'i tshes bzang la/ gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug mngon dga' rtse ru gtan la phab pa u ya mu tsug smar ro//
